source_text: Finis Libri Secundi. Sequitur Liber Tertius, ubi amplius de pulchritudine sponsi et de cubili atque de floribus campi prosequemur. Hactenus a Nigra sum usque ad Cubile nostrum umbrosum, Domino adiuvante, digessimus. Amen.
pass_a_gloss: End of-Book Second. Follows Book Third, where more-fully about beauty of-bridegroom and about couch and about flowers of-field we-shall-pursue...
pass_b_english: End of the Second Book. The Third Book follows, where we shall pursue further the Bridegroom’s beauty and the couch and the flowers of the field. Thus far, from I am black through Our couch is shaded, with the Lord’s help, we have set things in order. Amen.
